This sorghum plot is small, only a little piece near the house. I keep my sorghum the old way — seed I saved from last harvest, and the manure from my cattle goes on it because I have animals and the dung is there anyway. I do not buy fertilizer for sorghum; that little bag costs too much for such a small piece of land, and sorghum grows even without it if the rains come. I weed with my wife and children, two or three times in the season, and that is enough work for this plot.
